subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` default to reconnecting, waiting, and cache-replaying an accepted Gateway run before using the existing isolated embedded fallback when the outcome remains unknown?
rationale: The choice changes observable CLI latency, stdout semantics, streaming behavior, duplicate side-effect exposure, and possible `--deliver` behavior; source review cannot determine the intended public contract.

options.title: Approve reattach-first with retained fallback
options.body: Make exact Gateway-result recovery the default after an accepted uncertain disconnect, while preserving fresh isolated fallback only after recovery cannot establish an outcome.

options.title: Keep recook-first behavior
options.body: Retain the current immediate isolated embedded fallback contract and close this broader recovery change while keeping the previously landed session containment.

options.title: Adopt a mode-specific policy
options.body: Specify different recovery behavior for `--deliver` and interactive stdout paths, with separate documentation and proof for each mode.

recommendation.title: Approve reattach-first with retained fallback
recommendation.body: Make exact Gateway-result recovery the default after an accepted uncertain disconnect, while preserving fresh isolated fallback only after recovery cannot establish an outcome.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged abnormal-close fallback work defines the current behavior this PR changes.
